Bombay High Court Bans Firecrackers on Public Roads

The Bombay High Court has issued a strict order prohibiting the bursting of firecrackers on public roads. The court also deemed the use of loudspeakers during festivals inappropriate. The order specifically targets public roads for firecracker use and questions the appropriateness of loudspeakers in celebrations.
